newsitem.title: MALTA: Short term yield up fractionally in Malta markets.
newsitem.headline: Short term yield up fractionally in Malta markets.

text.p: The one-week Central Bank of Malta reverse repo rate was up slightly at the start of the week at 5.0800 percent from 5.0713 the week before.

Treasury bill yields were unchanged for one month, three- month and six-month terms at 5.0211 percent, 5.0299 percent and 5.2865 percent respectively. The yield on 12-month treasury bills rose slightly to 5.3959 percent from 5.3933 percent.
The Central Bank of Malta discount rate is 5.50 percent and the repo rate 5.40 percent.
